purpose: Exact-hash incremental successor to reviewed-overlay v3. Each accepted row binds one construction project and physical site to one closed portable bridge. Geometry authority and use scope remain exactly those of each bridge, all rejected claims survive, and no proximity-only or fuzzy-name identity is accepted.

The geometry is accepted only as an official-source project_locator reference point; it is not a centroid, footprint, parcel, campus boundary, construction extent, or accuracy claim, and every bridge rejection remains rejected.
